ch0196_11_fleurdelis/0101_0701_02_10:
What sort of future could this be hinting at?
You’ll have to show me what possibilities
are in store.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7101_0701_01_10:
Humanity’s overgrown sense of greed has
the potential to devour the world and bring
about its destruction.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7101_0701_02_10:
If we head down that path, someone must
put a stop to it.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7101_0701_03_10:
At times, ruin is necessary to mete out
justice.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7102_0701_01_10:
Many blindly believe there will always be a
tomorrow, just like the day before.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7102_0701_02_10:
A world endlessly continuing, remaining
the same...
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7102_0701_03_10: There is simply no guarantee of that.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7103_0701_01_10: To gain something, you must lose something.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7103_0701_02_10:
Do you understand? Progress requires
sacrifice.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7103_0701_03_10: That’s the way of the world.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7104_0701_01_10:
Determining right from wrong is incredibly
difficult.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7104_0701_02_10: That’s why I’ve settled on observing.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7104_0701_03_10:
I’ll look broadly at the world to see if it has
anything worth preserving...until a deadline
that’s not far off.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7105_0701_01_10:
Whenever I meet innocent children like you,
[Name:PlayerNickname ], it makes me
think...
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7105_0701_02_10:
Is it acceptable for children’s futures to be
taken for the convenience of adults?
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/7105_0701_03_10:
But I refuse to bend on my principles. I can’t
turn back.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/1701_0702_01_10: Between us, sharing goes both ways.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/1701_0702_02_10: I hope that continues for a long time.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2501_0701_01_10:
Suppose there were something in this world
you longed for—something one of a kind.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2501_0701_02_10:
What would you do if someone claimed it for
themselves?
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2501_0701_03_10:
There was a similar story in legends
surrounding Chi-Yu, so I was curious how
you would respond.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2501_0702_02_10:
All humans have embers of envy smoldering
in their hearts.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2511_0701_01_10:
From another’s perspective, what I’m trying
to achieve could be seen as a calamity.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2511_0701_02_10:
But if it’s to preserve a beautiful world,
I don’t care what happens!
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2511_0702_01_10:
Ruin... Is it for the world, for humanity, for
Pokémon, or for everything?
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2511_0702_02_10:
In the end, we can only know after changing
the world.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/3001_0701_01_10:
The morning sun shines brightly and equally
upon the world. That is what makes it
beautiful.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/3003_0701_01_10:
The world granted us our existence, and
thus we live... All in order to accomplish
what we must do.
ch0196_11_fleurdelis/3005_0701_01_10:
The fire of conviction within our hearts
is the only thing that illuminates the darkness
looming over tomorrow.
